blocks.text: How corporate trainers manage administrative tasks

Your day as a corporate trainer is rarely just about training. You manage scheduling, track learner progress, and handle endless email chains. These administrative burdens often take up the majority of your time. When you use training material creation software, you want it to support your workflow rather than add to your administrative load. Lazur assists by helping you find information or manage your calendar without leaving your current app.
The cost of app switching in training development

You likely move between an Learning Management System, a presentation tool, and your email client throughout the day. Every time you switch, your brain spends time reorienting. This is why you feel drained by mid-afternoon. If you use tools like Articulate 360 or ActivePresenter, you already have complex interfaces to manage. Adding more windows makes it harder to stay in the zone.
Using training material creation software effectively

When building content in PowerPoint or Keynote, you need to be precise. You might want to add a transition in Keynote or format a slide in PowerPoint. Instead of hunting through menus, you can ask Lazur to point at the specific button you need. This saves you from clicking through nested menus like Format > Slide Layout > Change.

items: Use ⌥ ⌘ to ask Lazur where a specific setting is located on your screen.
Ask Lazur to explain how to perform a task, like adding a video to a slide.
Dictate your speaker notes using the fn key to keep your hands on the keyboard.
Keep your training documentation organized by asking Lazur to draft summaries of your research.

blocks.text: If you work with sensitive learner data, ensure you follow your organization's specific data privacy policies. Lazur does not store your screen data or audio, but you are responsible for how you handle confidential information in your documents.
blocks.title: Data Privacy Reminder

blocks.text: Research is a major part of updating your training materials. You might need to verify a statistic or find a new example for your course. Lazur can perform research in its own Chrome tabs, allowing you to stay in your content creation app. Once the research is done, Lazur summarizes the findings for you. You can then copy this text into your document or slide deck.

Writing speaker notes is often the last thing you want to do after designing slides. With Lazur, you can hold the fn key and dictate your thoughts. It handles formatting and punctuation, which means you spend less time editing. This is particularly useful when you have a lot of content to cover in a short time. You can also use it to draft emails to your trainees or stakeholders.

faq.question: Can Lazur edit my PowerPoint files directly?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons, edit files, or operate other apps for you. It points at things, explains steps, and helps you get your work done by guiding you.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with my Learning Management System?
faq.answer: Lazur works as a voice assistant on your Mac. It can help you find buttons or explain features in any web-based LMS you open in your browser.

faq.question: Is my data safe when using Lazur?
faq.answer: Lazur only listens and looks at your screen when you hold the shortcut keys. Audio and screenshots are sent to AI providers to answer your request and are not stored. Your content is never used to train AI models.
